name: reviewsai
description: Manage Google Business Profile reviews: read reviews, draft AI replies in your brand voice, publish approved replies, track profile stats and Google Maps ranking.

interface.longDescription:
ReviewsAI connects ChatGPT to your Google Business Profile locations managed in ReviewsAI.

- See new and unanswered Google reviews across all your locations, filtered by rating or date.
- Draft personalized replies in your brand voice, tone and signature, in the reviewer's language.
- Publish a reply on Google only after you approve the exact text.
- Check profile performance: views on Search and Maps, calls, website clicks and direction requests.
- Measure your Google Maps ranking for a keyword on a grid around your business and review past scans.

Requires a ReviewsAI account (free plan available) with at least one Google Business Profile connected. ReviewsAI is independent software and is not affiliated with Google.
defaultPrompt: Show my unanswered Google reviews from this week
Draft replies to my latest negative reviews
How many calls did my business get last month?
